provider: HAL (Hyper Articles en Ligne, CCSD / CNRS)

free_tier.stated: 200 MB maximum per file in the deposit UI, plus a 5 GB per-account FTP staging space that is provisional only: 'pour une durée provisoire pouvant aller jusqu'à 31 jours maximum'. No aggregate storage quota is published.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: | Very stable national infrastructure (CCSD/CNRS) with permanent URLs, but the per-file 200 MB cap and the bibliographic-record model make it useless for bulk blobs; the 5 GB FTP space decays in 31 days.

egress.terms: Free public PDF/fulltext download, no metering; metadata is harvested by OpenAIRE, BASE, Google Scholar.

tooling: Deposit API + SWORD for programmatic submission (api.archives-ouvertes.fr/docs), FTP staging at ftp.ccsd.cnrs.fr with explicit TLS (FileZilla), OAI-PMH, and a TripleStore. This is a genuinely automatable write path.
chaining: Unlimited deposits x 200 MB/file — 2,500 files for 500 GB, but each deposit is a bibliographic notice, so the multiplier is records not blobs. 5 GB FTP staging expires in 31 days.

limits.value: transfer is limited to 3 MB/file and 10 MB total

limits_note: Per-object-cap 200 MB (soft, varies with traffic); FTP staging 5 GB / 31 days; the deposit must be a scholarly document with a document type, so raw data blobs are out of scope. arXiv transfer is limited to 3 MB/file and 10 MB total.
